# Junyao Jiang Personal Website (generated by codex)

This is a GitHub Pages compatible Jekyll site.

## Deploy on GitHub Pages

1. Upload all files in this folder to the root of the `jiang-junyao.github.io` repository.
2. In GitHub, open `Settings > Pages`.
3. Set `Build and deployment` to `Deploy from a branch`.
4. Select the default branch, usually `main`, and the root folder `/`.
5. Save. The site will be available at `https://jiang-junyao.github.io`.

## Local preview

The `preview.html`, `preview-news.html`, and `preview-gallery.html` files are standalone local previews. They are excluded from the GitHub Pages build.

For a Jekyll build locally, install Ruby and Bundler, then run:

```bash
bundle install
bundle exec jekyll serve
```
